title: SDK Starter Kits: Cohort-Based Fast-Feedback Rollout for High-Value Integrations
creator: Aisha Gomez
description: Run a cohort-based pilot that delivers lightweight SDK Starter Kits (opinionated repo, minimal sample app, and a one-page quickstart) to 3 developer cohorts (marketplace integrations, internal platform teams, and partner ISVs). The goal is to iterate on content, templates, and onboarding tooling rapidly, measure time-to-first-success and retention, and produce a repeatable rollout playbook for Q2. This ticket covers the product plan, cohort selection, measurement plan (OKRs and weekly signals), required engineering touchpoints, and success criteria. Deliverables: cohort roster + outreach messages, three starter kit repos, analytics dashboard queries, and a consolidated retrospective with action items for scale.
okrs: O: Reduce time-to-first-success for SDK adopters
KR1: Median time-to-first-success <= 45 minutes for pilot cohorts
KR2: 30% of cohort developers complete end-to-end integration within 7 days
KR3: Gather qualitative feedback (NPS-like) >= +30 from cohort participants
acceptance_criteria: Three starter kit repositories exist with CI that runs sample flows
Quickstart doc (1 pager) validated by at least two cohort developers
Dashboard queries and charts surface TTF-success, drop-off step, and activation funnel
Playbook doc with outreach templates, expected timelines, and follow-up experiments
Retrospective with prioritized backlog and owners for scale work

Follow-ups likely: automation for repo templating, improved telemetry hooks in SDKs, and a localization pass for docs in Q3.
